title: Travel and staying somewhere
description: Buy tickets, ask about departures and arrivals, find your seat, and take a room in a hotel.

guide.title: Tickets and trains
guide.text:
টিকিট (tikit) ticket. A ticket TO a place uses the possessive: ঢাকার টিকিট, 'Dhaka's ticket'. 'To buy a ticket' is টিকিট কাটা, literally 'to cut a ticket'.

ছাড়া (chhaaraa) to leave, depart: ট্রেনটা কখন ছাড়বে? 'When will the train leave?'
পৌঁছানো (pounchhaano) to arrive, reach: আমরা কখন পৌঁছাব? 'When will we arrive?'
ওঠা (othaa) to get on; নামা (naamaa) to get off.

প্ল্যাটফর্ম (plyaatphorm) platform; সিট (sit) seat; মালপত্র (maalpotro) luggage; পরের স্টেশন (porer steshon) the next station; দেরি (deri) delay: ট্রেন দেরিতে আসছে, 'the train is running late'.

খালি (khaali) means 'empty, free, vacant': a seat, a room, a taxi.

guide.title: Taking a room
guide.text:
ঘর (ghor) is a room (in Bangladesh usually রুম, rum). ঘর খালি আছে? 'Is a room free?'

ভাড়া (bhaaraa) is the charge: এক রাতের ভাড়া কত? 'one night's rent how much?'

To say how long you will stay, use থাকা with the number of days or nights: আমরা দুদিন থাকব, 'we will stay two days'. দুদিন (dudin) is 'two days'; তিন রাত, 'three nights'; এক সপ্তাহ, 'a week'.

Useful things to ask about: গরম জল (gorom jol) hot water; এসি (esi) air conditioning; পাখা (paakhaa) fan; চাবি (chaabi) key; তোয়ালে (toyaale) towel.

এই যে (ei je), 'here it is', is what you say when handing something over or pointing it out: এই যে আমার পাসপোর্ট।

examples.english: Do you have a room free?
How much is it for one night?

guide.title: 'Where shall I ...?' and 'May I ...?'
guide.text:
The first-person future as a question asks for instructions: মালপত্র কোথায় রাখব? 'Where shall I put the luggage?'; কোথায় নামব? 'Where should I get off?'; ট্যাক্সি কোথায় পাব? 'Where will I get a taxi?'

For permission, use the -te form + পারি: ঘরটা একটু দেখতে পারি? 'May I have a look at the room?'

Both are softened, as always, with একটু.

examples.english: Where shall I put the luggage?
Where can I get a taxi?

phrases.english: Which platform will the train come to?
I'll get off at the next station.
Where shall I put the luggage?
Where can I get a taxi?
Do you have a room free?
How much is it for one night?

phrases.note: এই যে is said when handing something over.
